ios.desc:
TransDO is a fast and simple multilingual translator. It supports voice input with playback, photo translation, AI-powered chat, and quick notes, letting you save and access translations anytime, anywhere.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

show_hn.title: Show HN: TransDo – Translate text, speech, and photos with AI support

quotes.text: Hi HN! I built TransDo, a simple and intuitive translation app. It supports text input, voice input, and photo translation, and also integrates AI chat. I wanted something faster and more minimal than Google Translate, with history and notes included. The iOS version is live now, and an Android version is coming soon. Would love your feedback on UX and feature set! iOS: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/transdo/id6746675000 (Android coming soon)
